events.text: Ten Class 11E 4-4-0 locomotives built at Gorton workshops.

evidence.quote: Ten were built in the railways own workshops at Gorton , Manchester during 1913

events.text: Locomotive no. 429 renamed Sir Douglas Haig.

evidence.quote: so in 1917 no . 429 was renamed Sir Douglas Haig

events.text: Locomotive no. 437 renamed Prince George after King George V's fifth child.

evidence.quote: Charles Stuart-Wortley was raised to the peerage as Baron Stuart of Wortley in 1917

events.text: Locomotive no. 429 renamed a second time, to Prince Henry.

evidence.quote: Sir Douglas was created Earl Haig in 1919

events.text: LNER added 5000 to GCR class numbers after the 1923 Grouping.

events.label: accident
events.text: No. 5437 Prince George, hauling an express passenger train, collided with a light engine in Yorkshire

evidence.quote: On 27 February 1927 , locomotive No . 5437 Prince George was hauling an express passenger train that was involved in a collision with a light engine at Yorkshire

events.text: British Railways increased class numbers by 60000.

undated_mentions: Class remained in service until the mid-1950s (withdrawal)
